title: ⚠️ Valentine's Day Reminder: Don’t Be the Side Story, Be the Love Story ❤️✝️
paragraphs: ⚠️ Valentine's Day Reminder: Don’t Be the Side Story, Be the Love Story ❤️✝️
Ladies (and gentlemen), don’t let temporary pleasure steal your worth! A married man is not yours to keep—he’s already bound by God to someone else. Love should be pure, not stolen.

✨ God's Design for Love & Marriage:
📖 "Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure, for God will judge the adulterer and all the sexually immoral." – Hebrews 13:4
📖 "Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap." – Galatians 6:7

If he’s married, he’s not available—no matter what lies he tells you. Choose God’s best for you, not someone else’s leftovers. True love waits for the right person, at the right time, in the right way.
This Valentine’s Day, choose purity, choose self-respect, and choose God’s plan for your life. ❤️
